SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS FemalePatientsWithoutSymptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN "Laboratory" "a" ON "p"."ID" = "a"."ID"
WHERE p.SEX = 'F' 
  AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') 
  AND e.Symptoms IS NULL
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada') ORDER BY birthday ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
SELECT location, lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE country = 'Austria'
SELECT res.time FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.year = 2008 AND r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND res.position = 1
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule AS m JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '+'

WITH RankedAtoms AS (SELECT a.element, a.molecule_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY a.atom_id) AS atom_rank FROM atom AS a JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+') SELECT element FROM RankedAtoms WHERE atom_rank = 4 GROUP BY element
SELECT s.School, s.Street FROM frpm AS f JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE ABS(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30

SELECT DISTINCT d.type AS account_type
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON "a"."account_id" = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 8000 AND di.A11 <= 9000
AND d.type != 'OWNER'
AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);
